properties.name: synapse.data.stores.*.jpa.properties
properties.description: Hibernate and JPA properties for the store's EntityManagerFactory, such as hibernate.jdbc.batch_size. Schema keys (hibernate.hbm2ddl.*, jakarta.persistence.schema-generation.* and javax.persistence.schema-generation.*) and connection keys (jakarta.persistence.jdbc.*, javax.persistence.jdbc.*, the JPA data source keys, and hibernate.connection.url, username, user, password, driver_class, provider_class and datasource) fail startup: use jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto and the store's url, username and password instead. Replace * with the store name.

properties.name: synapse.data.stores.*.jpa.mapping-resources
properties.description: Mapping resources of the store's persistence unit (the mapping-file entries of a persistence.xml), added after Synapse's own.

properties.name: synapse.data.stores.*.jpa.database-platform
properties.description: Hibernate dialect class for the store. By default Hibernate resolves the dialect from the vendor module's database product name.

properties.name: synapse.data.stores.*.jpa.database
properties.description: Target database of the store, as Spring's Database enum, instead of the vendor module's.

properties.name: synapse.data.stores.*.jpa.show-sql
properties.description: Whether Hibernate logs the store's SQL statements.

properties.name: synapse.data.stores.*.jpa.generate-ddl
properties.description: Not used to change the schema: true fails startup. Use jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto instead.

properties.name: synapse.data.stores.*.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto
properties.description: Schema action the store runs when it starts, after its migrations: none, validate, update, create or create-drop. Defaults to validate when Flyway is on the class path, else none. update, create and create-drop fail startup unless the store sets allow-ddl-auto.

properties.name: synapse.data.stores.*.jpa.hibernate.naming.physical-strategy
properties.description: Fully qualified name of the store's physical naming strategy. A PhysicalNamingStrategy bean for the store wins over it.

properties.name: synapse.data.stores.*.jpa.hibernate.naming.implicit-strategy
properties.description: Fully qualified name of the store's implicit naming strategy. An ImplicitNamingStrategy bean for the store wins over it.
